items.question: In the UAE, how many female employees must a federal government ministry or institution have before it is expected to set up an on-site nursery for employees' children under Cabinet Resolution No. 19 of 2006?
items.fact: Cabinet Resolution 19 of 2006 requires nurseries at 50+ female employees

items.question: Which UAE federal law governs child care nurseries, and what year was it issued?
items.gold: Federal Law No. 5 of 1983 on Child Care Nurseries.
items.fact: Federal Law No. 5 of 1983 regulates child care nurseries
